    The representation-theoretic correction in primitive directed deletion #

    This file combines the two nonnegative terms in the live manuscript's directed-deletion theorem. All three quantities are the literal categorical ones attached to a primitive quotient:

    • the intrinsic Euler excess of the strict tau-factor;
    • the total increase of intrinsic irreducible-arrow multiplicities; and
    • the number of new quotient meshes.

    The direct vertex--arrow--mesh count identifies this correction with the difference of the ambient and primitive-quotient Auslander--Reiten surpluses; factor positivity and arrow-gain dominance then give monotonicity and the equality rigidity statement used downstream.
